instruction: I'd like to see the network speed indicator in the system tray. Please enable this feature.

metadata.explanation: This task asks to display network speed in the system tray, a system-level indicator that is infeasible to validate programmatically. Similar pattern to the original battery percentage display request.

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator correctly uses 'infeasible' function for a task that cannot be programmatically verified
Network speed indicators in the system tray are dynamic visual elements that cannot be reliably validated programmatically
No way to verify that the indicator is actually showing accurate real-time network speed data
The metadata explanation correctly describes why this verification is infeasible
The 'infeasible()' function is a valid placeholder in the metrics module for such cases
